acceptance.artifact: terminal-state guard plus non-regression projection plus recurrence tests
acceptance.assertion: A resubmission against a unit that has reached COMPLETED is refused and durably recorded, the projection never regresses a unit out of COMPLETED, and no unit can ever accumulate two COMPLETED events. Reproduced by the coordinator on 2026-08-22: a unit completed with commitA was regressed to PARENT_INGESTED by a non-identical resubmission and re-completed with commitB, yielding two COMPLETED events for one unit while scan_recovery reported zero false completions. A legitimate retry after FAILED_TERMINAL must still be possible, and must require a fresh coordinator-issued lease rather than being admitted silently.
acceptance.falsified_if: any unit can reach COMPLETED twice, or a completed result's artifacts can be swapped, or a legitimate retry after terminal failure becomes impossible

hypothesis: A unit that is already COMPLETED can be silently regressed and completed a second time with entirely different artifacts, because idempotency keys on a hash of the whole result document rather than on unit identity, ingestion has no terminal-state guard, the projection lets a later event regress out of COMPLETED, and cmd_complete checks only the current state rather than whether the unit was ever completed.
